subject: Catalyst Analytics: 'Inference at Scale' co-promo play & staffing runbook
messages:
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@catalyst-analytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-promo idea — joint webinar + shared booth at CloudInference ’26

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well — I’m Alyssa on the partnerships team at Catalyst Analytics. We loved Redwood’s recent latency benchmarks and think a joint webinar titled 'Inference at Scale: Cost, Latency, and Real Deployments' would resonate with both of our audiences. We’re also planning our tradeshow presence at CloudInference ’26 (Sept 28–30) and would like to propose a shared island booth and a co-branded webinar the week before the show.

High-level asks from our side:
- Joint 45-minute webinar (technical + customer panel) — target date: week of Sep 20–24
- Shared 10x20 island booth at CloudInference — staffing split + signage co-branding
- MDF support: Catalyst can contribute $15k, looking to request up to $25k from Redwood to cover shared booth build, promo, and webinar ad spend
- One joint dry-run week of Sep 13 for speaker rehearsal

I attached a short MDF proposal and a rough booth footprint. Can you loop in the right folks on Redwood’s side and let me know if this is feasible? Happy to hop on a quick call next week.

Best,
Alyssa Greene
Head of Partner Marketing, Catalyst Analytics
[Attachment: Catalyst_MDF_proposal_v1.pdf (pdf)]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@catalyst-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-promo idea — joint webinar + shared booth at CloudInference ’26

Hi Alyssa — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the proposal and the clear asks. Looping in Ben (field marketing / events) and Marissa (partner ops) to scope MDF, staffing, and booth ops.

Quick thoughts from my side:
- Webinar: we can commit to a 45-min format with a 30-min panel + 15-min customer Q&A. Preferred dates are Sep 21 or Sep 23. Can you confirm your preferred speakers and one customer for the panel?
- Booth: shared 10x20 island sounds right. We typically staff 4 people per day for a shared booth and rotate SMEs — will confirm roster after Ben chimes in.
- MDF: $25k total ask is within the range we evaluate for co-sponsor events; we’ll need a short MOU and a cost breakdown (line items) before approvals.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to provide a line-item budget and recommended staffing schedule.
2) Catalyst to confirm webinar speaker list + customer panelist.
3) Draft a 1-page MOU (we can use DocuSign) capturing MDF split, deliverables, logos, and usage rights.

Ben/Marissa — thoughts? Alyssa — if you can confirm speakers + panelist by Mon 7/20 that will speed approvals.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Greene <alyssa@catalyst-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-promo idea — joint webinar + shared booth at CloudInference ’26

Thanks Kim / Alyssa — I ran a quick ops pass. Draft numbers below (ballpark):

Booth (shared 10x20) — total est: $38,000
- Shell + graphics: $18,000
- Furniture & AV: $8,000
- Freight & drayage: $6,000
- On-site labor: $6,000

Marketing / webinar promotion — total est: $12,000
- Paid social + InMail: $6,000
- Email send & list rental: $3,000
- Creative (1x co-branded LP & assets): $3,000

Total program cost: $50,000
Catalyst propose $15,000 contribution; Redwood contribution request: $25,000 (rest to be covered by internal event budget or sponsorship credits).

Staffing recommendation (per day, Sept 28–30):
- Day 1 (Wed): 1 AE, 1 Solutions Engineer, 2 SDRs
- Day 2 (Thu): 1 Growth PM, 1 Developer Advocate, 2 SDRs
- Day 3 (Fri): 1 CS lead, 1 Partner Manager, 2 SDRs

I attached a staffing roster template and a booth footprint with suggested placement for demo station, lead capture, and partner signage.

Risks / asks from Redwood ops:
- Need MOU to lock in MDF and deliverables (will not allocate until signed)
- Firewall for lead sharing: Catalyst must agree to our lead-processing SLA (we won’t share PII until legal signoff)
- Travel approvals for SEs — will budget headcount but travel needs manager OK.

If that budget looks acceptable, I’ll draft the one-pager MOU and route for signatures.

Attachments: [Staffing_Roster.xlsx], [Booth_Footprint_SKU.png]

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@catalyst-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: devs@catalyst-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-promo idea — joint webinar + shared booth at CloudInference ’26

Thanks Ben — appreciate the detailed breakdown, that helps a lot. Catalyst can confirm the $15k contribution and we’re comfortable with the staffing split you suggested. A few quick items from our side:
- Speakers: Alyssa Greene (me, partnership lead) + Dr. Robert Lin (CTO, Catalyst) + Redwood speaker (Kim or SE). Customer panel: we can secure a mid-market retailer currently on a POC with us — they’ve agreed verbally.
- Webinar preferred date: Sep 23, 11am PT. We can handle webinar hosting (Zoom Webinar) and will send marketing assets by Aug 15.
- MOU: please send a DocuSign link; we prefer standard 60-day payment terms after the show.

We’ve uploaded a short MOU draft on our side and can drop it into DocuSign once Redwood’s one-pager is ready. Also proposing a dry-run rehearsal on Sep 14 at 10am PT — does that work for your speakers?

Looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Alyssa

Action items (owners):

- Kim: I will provide Redwood speaker and two talking points for the webinar by 7/24
- Marissa: Signoff on MDF allocation / route DocuSign — due 7/22
- All: Confirm dry-run on 9/14 at 10am PT; calendar invite pending

Thanks — let’s aim to keep communications to this thread for auditability.
